versions.changelog:
Initial release of Huawei Cloud ELB monitoring skill for Cloud Eye Service (CES):

- Provides real-time and historical ELB monitoring for Shared and Dedicated types via Huawei Cloud CLI
- Supports connection metrics, traffic metrics, HTTP status code analysis (Dedicated ELB), and performance indicators
- Includes scenario-driven monitoring workflows: performance checks, traffic analysis, troubleshooting, and capacity planning
- Enforces secure credential handling and IAM permission guidance
- Offers clear, step-by-step workflow for listing ELBs, determining capabilities, and querying relevant metrics
